meaning: The owner accepted the architecture direction: local playable instrument sources driven by symbolic composition material is the correct path for foundational music elements. This does not mean every rendered candidate is individually approved.
approvedDirection: Use playable local instrument sources instead of fixed finished songs as the core music foundation.
Use harmony, motif, form, grammar, tempo, seed, and instrument choice as separate controllable inputs.
Continue producing Sleep, Calm, and Focus variants through deterministic composition routing.
Keep Lyria as a possible gap filler or color source, not the default engine for foundational instruments.
notApprovedYet: No individual rendered candidate is formal usable yet.
No candidate may enter public Recipe routing until item-level human listening passes.
The two FluidR3 SoundFont sources are still blocked until a runtime loader or replacement source is verified.
The current review does not approve voice, choir, drums, percussion, therapeutic claims, or generic broadband-noise foregrounds.

nextProductionStep.description: Produce the next controllable foundational music batch from approved direction: more variants across piano, Rhodes, guitar, bass support, and a replacement or loader-backed woodwind source.
